description: This file defines the 'TrimMargins' class in the PdfSharp.Pdf namespace, representing the margins to trim on a PDF page. It includes properties for each margin, a method to set all margins simultaneously, and a property to check if any margin is set.

classes.name: TrimMargins
classes.description: Represents trim margins added to a PDF page, with properties for each margin and utility methods for margin management.

methods.name: All
methods.description: Sets all four trim margins (Left, Right, Top, Bottom) to the specified value.

methods.name: AreSet
methods.description: Indicates whether any of the margins are set to a value other than zero.
